title: Cow eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- grass patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='40' ry='7' fill='#2f7a3f'/>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='60' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='71' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8e3d4'/>
  <rect x='42' y='79' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#e8e3d4'/>
  <rect x='56' y='79' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#e8e3d4'/>
  <rect x='68' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8e3d4'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='88' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='42' y='88' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='88' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='88' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='52' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='45' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='42' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8e3d4' transform='rotate(-20 88 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='42' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f0b8c0' transform='rotate(-20 88 42)'/>
  <!-- horn -->
  <path d='M86 44 Q92 38 90 32 Q86 36 84 42 Z' fill='#e0c060'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='82.8' cy='48.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='90' cy='58' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#f0b8c0'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='89' cy='57' rx='1.4' ry='1.8' fill='#b07080'/>
  <ellipse cx='93' cy='57' rx='1.4' ry='1.8' fill='#b07080'/>
  <!-- mouth chewing -->
  <path d='M87 61 Q90 64 94 61' stroke='#b07080' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: a leafy green sprig in mouth -->
  <path d='M94 62 Q99 58 97 52 Q93 56 93 61 Z' fill='#4fc94f'/>
  <path d='M95 61 Q100 60 99 55 Q96 58 95 61 Z' fill='#3aa83a'/>
  <path d='M95 60 L96 53' stroke='#2a7a2a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 60 Q16 58 15 66' stroke='#e8e3d4' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
</svg>
